title: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B, vs. $3.55B est., a net loss of $709M, and a $132.5B revenue backlog, up from $104B as of June (Jordan Novet/CNBC)

author: CNBC
content_snippet:

title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows.

summary_en: The Grok Build platform by SpaceXSI has been exposed for a critical URL enumeration flaw, leading to the public leak of thousands of user apps and sensitive business data, including internal plans and employee information. Even SpaceXSI, the platform's own creator, saw its internal documents compromised, highlighting severe security oversight in its rapid development cycle.

summary_en: Graphon, based in San Francisco, raised $35 million in Series A funding to develop software that maps connections between documents, videos, and images. title: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 completes 41 percent of real freelance jobs, up from 2.5 percent a year ago

content_snippet:
Anthropic's new model Fable 5.2 makes a massive leap on the Remote Labor Index, completing more than 41 percent of real freelance projects at professional quality. The system leaves both its direct predecessor and the entire competition far behind.

summary_en: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model has achieved a 41.3% success rate on the Remote Labor Index, completing professional freelance projects at a standard acceptable to paying clients. Processes have become larger and control systems smarter, but the fundamental science behind separating metals from ores has changed less than many realize.
